description: The fixed Bool interpretations certify: an S4 boxed-conditional model with both possibilities and neither necessity; a universal S5 actual-only-conditional model failing the boxed conditional and both necessities; a nonserial empty K5 model with both necessities and neither possibility; a disconnected identity S5 model with opposite component necessities but neither global alternative; and separate constant universal models witnessing each rival possibility while excluding the other.
